# David Packer Recommends Handstand Push-Ups And Dips As A Foundation For Planche

David Packer recommends building a foundation of handstand push-ups and dips before training the planche, as his beginner students achieved an advanced tuck planche after about two months with this approach. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]

## Details

- The starting exercises are handstand push-ups, weighted dips, and hollow body straight body dips with forward lean. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- Beginner students who could do five to ten full range of motion wall handstand push-ups achieved an advanced tuck planche after about two months. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- Start with half range of motion handstand push-ups or pike push-ups, building up to five to ten full range of motion reps. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- For progressing from advanced tuck to straddle planche, keep grinding handstand push-ups rather than doing specific dynamics. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- Focus on getting strong at the basics; light bands and progressions are helpful only when close to the skill. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]

## Evidence

- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (David Packer): "handstand push-ups would be and handstand push-ups dips but there are two types of dips i'll focus on weighted dips the regular ones and then it would be hollow body um straight body dips with forward lean those were the two or three exercises that i always got my uh beginner students to do"
- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (David Packer): "wall handstand push-ups they could do i think it was like five to ten second advanced tuck after about two months or so which is pretty good you know coming from you saw you see a lot of guys that don't even have you know a tuck planche and then they're just attempting it for months and months"
- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (David Packer): "i'd have handstand push-ups down half start off with half rom do pike if you need to at the beginning build up to you know reps of you know five full rom and that's pretty that's really a pretty good level like you know five to ten full rom"
- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (David Packer): "i'll just keep grinding those handstand push-ups and like you can you don't need to do all these dynamics where it's like you know advanced top to straddle and then you go back and then you know there's reps like that this yeah there's so many things that you don't really need to do just focus on the basics"
